resumeText:
Kavya Menon | Mumbai, Maharashtra | kavya.menon.mktg@example.com

EDUCATION
BMS (Marketing), Juhu College of Commerce and Management, Mumbai (2023 - 2026) | CGPA 8.3/10

INTERNSHIPS
Digital Marketing Intern, Konkan Coffee Roasters, Mumbai (Apr 2025 - Jun 2025, 10 weeks)
- Ran a Rs 8,000 Google Ads search campaign for the online store and tracked clicks and cost per click every day.
- Planned and posted 36 Instagram posts and reels; followers grew from 2,100 to 3,400.
- Wrote four blog posts on brewing methods for the website.

Content Intern, Western Line Media, Mumbai (Dec 2024 - Jan 2025, 6 weeks)
- Rewrote page titles and meta descriptions for 25 blog pages to target local search keywords.

PROJECTS
- College fest social media (Tarang, the annual college fest): Managed the fest Instagram and LinkedIn pages and coordinated a team of six volunteers for posts and stories.
- Marketing research project: Surveyed 120 students on food delivery app loyalty and presented findings to the faculty panel.

CERTIFICATIONS AND COURSEWORK
- Google Ads Search certification; HubSpot Content Marketing certification
- Coursework: Consumer Behaviour, Digital Marketing, Marketing Research, Advertising

SKILLS
Google Ads, Meta Ads, Google Analytics (GA4), SEO, Instagram, Canva, Content writing, MS Excel

ACTIVITIES
- Head of Publicity, college Marketing Club
- Anchor for the college annual day
